verdict.line: You lose if you walk into Q-E stun chains at zero resources; you win every all-in from level 2 onward if you track his W charge count.

brief.thesis: Camille vs Ornn is close to a coinflip at 50.7% over 1306 games, but the shape is lopsided in pacing: Camille has the lane and solo-kill edge because her E (Hookshot) threat range forces Ornn to play passively, while Ornn's entire kit is built around punishing the moment Camille commits to a dash. Whoever controls when the stick-together happens wins the exchange.

theirWindow.when: His E is up and you're near a wall
theirWindow.what: If Ornn's E (Searing Charge) is off cooldown (14/13.5/13/12.5/12s) and you're within charge range of terrain, he can collide into the wall for a knock-up shockwave, then follow with Q (Volcanic Rupture) slow into W (Bellows Breath) Brittle for a full stun-lock trade. Back off walls when his E is up and you don't have Q (Precision Protocol) charged to punish the long animation.

yourWindow.when: His E and Q are both down
yourWindow.what: The instant Ornn's E (Searing Charge) and Q (Volcanic Rupture) are both on cooldown, he has no slow, no knock-up, and no gap-close — walk him down with auto-Q (Precision Protocol) resets and W (Tactical Sweep) for the heal-sustain trade. This is your only truly safe all-in window before level 6.

start.why: Picked in 75.5% of games at 51.5% win rate; the extra AD and sustain let you win extended Q (Precision Protocol) auto-trades before Ornn's armor from Living Forge scales up.

boots.why: 52.7% win rate over 54.3% pick rate; the magic resist and tenacity shortens how long you're locked down after his Q (Volcanic Rupture) slow into any follow-up CC.

core.why: Core first item at 51.9%+ win rates across all three listed builds; the damage and move speed proc lets your Q (Precision Protocol) and W (Tactical Sweep) punish his slower melee animations.
Second item in every listed core path; the sustain and cleave let you win extended trades where his Living Forge armor would otherwise outscale your raw AD.
Highest-sample third item (37.8% pick, 51.9% win rate); the damage-over-time conversion keeps you alive through his W (Bellows Breath) Brittle burst windows.

runes.keystoneWhy: Run at 49.5% over 25.4% pick rate; the proc heal and max-health stacking let you win the attrition war through Ornn's melee trades without relying on burst you don't have pre-6.

summoners.why: Flash+Teleport is the highest win-rate pairing at 49.6% over 31.9% pick rate; Teleport lets you reset top after an even trade and still make group fights where your Trinity Force spike matters.

playing.title: Hold E for his wall dashes
playing.detail: Don't throw Hookshot (E) to engage until you've baited Ornn near a wall; landing it there cuts off his own E (Searing Charge) escape and sets up your full combo.

playing.title: Track Q (Precision Protocol) recast timer
playing.detail: Delaying the Q (Precision Protocol) recast for the bonus damage window is worth it in any trade where Ornn doesn't have E (Searing Charge) up to punish you mid-recast.

playing.title: Respect Brittle stacking pre-6
playing.detail: Ornn's W (Bellows Breath) Brittle alone isn't lethal, but stacking it with his E (Searing Charge) wall-shockwave before level 6 can chain-CC you for a full trade loss.

playing.title: All-in during his double cooldown
playing.detail: Whenever both his Q (Volcanic Rupture, 9-7s) and E (Searing Charge, 14-12s) are down simultaneously, commit fully — he has no engage or peel tool left.

playing.title: Save Hookshot for his R redirect
playing.detail: After level 6, Ornn's R (Call of the Forge God) elemental can be redirected via recast for a second knock-up; keep E (Hookshot) up to reposition out of its second pass rather than using it offensively.

playing.title: Use W sustain to out-scale, not to poke
playing.detail: W (Tactical Sweep)'s outer-half slow and heal are best used reactively after he commits E (Searing Charge), not as a poke tool, since its delay lets him walk out of the cone.

playing.title: Itemize Death's Dance around his Brittle burst
playing.detail: Since his W (Bellows Breath) and R (Call of the Forge God) both threaten burst windows, Death's Dance's damage delay is more valuable here than raw lifesteal.

brief.patchCaveat: Build paths, runes, summoners, and all win rates above are measured from live OP.GG games on the current patch (16.19.1); the mechanical reasoning and trade timing are my own tactical read, not sourced data.

stats.opponentTip: Be careful of getting caught airborne with Ornn’s (Q)-(E) combo! Use Camille’s [P] and [W] to increase her sustain. Be careful of having Camille’s Hookshot[E] stun ignored while Ornn is using (W)!
